meta.name: manage-channels
meta.description: Wire channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, add new channel groups. Use after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把通道连接到智能体分组,管理隔离级别,新增通道分组
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要管理多个智能体分组,并需要控制它们之间的通道和隔离。
copy.tagline_en: Connect channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, and add channel groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage multiple agent groups and need to control channel wiring and isolation.

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 能检查并调整消息渠道与智能体群的连接：查看当前接线、接通新渠道、更改连接、添加同平台新群组，并管理隔离级别（含未知发送者策略）。
howto.when: 在添加新渠道后、初始设置中，或想独立重新配置现有连接时触发。

say.text: 查看当前渠道连接状态
say.note: Claude 会查询数据库并显示接线一览。

say.text: 把 Slack 的 #general 连接到 main-agent 群
say.note: Claude 会询问平台 ID 并按步骤完成接线。

say.text: 给 Telegram 再加一个群，接给独立智能体
say.note: Claude 会走配对流程并确认隔离方式。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can view and adjust channel-to-agent-group wiring: see current links, connect a new channel, change a link, add another group on the same platform, and manage isolation levels (incl. unknown-sender policy).
howto.when_en: Triggered after adding a channel, during initial setup, or as a standalone reconfigure.

say_en.note: Claude reads the DB and lists connections.

say_en.text: Connect Slack #general to the main-agent group
say_en.note: Claude asks for the platform ID and completes wiring.

say_en.text: Add a new Telegram group for a separate agent
say_en.note: Claude asks isolation preference and runs the pairing flow.
